title: ecbolium adhatoda
intro: Ecbolium adhatoda, commonly known as Vaseline plant or Adhatoda, is a plant species native to India and Sri Lanka. It has been traditionally used to treat various health conditions, including respiratory issues, fever, and inflammation, due to its numerous health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Ecbolium adhatoda include anti-inflammatory, antispasmodic, and expectorant properties, which help relieve coughs, asthma, and bronchitis. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
